MasulloGRH.dirichletPoleCleared_jensen {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (τ : ℝ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ)
  (hR : R ≠ 0) :
  Real.circleAverage (fun z => Real.log ‖MasulloGRH.dirichletPoleCleared χ τ z‖) c R =
    ∑ᶠ (z : ℂ),
          ↑((MeromorphicOn.divisor (MasulloGRH.dirichletPoleCleared χ τ) (Metric.closedBall c |R|)) z) *
            Real.log (R * ‖c - z‖⁻¹) +
        ↑((MeromorphicOn.divisor (MasulloGRH.dirichletPoleCleared χ τ) (Metric.closedBall c |R|)) c) * Real.log R +
      Real.log ‖meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt (MasulloGRH.dirichletPoleCleared χ τ) c‖
